title: eslint throwing on type error on global returns

labels.name: accepted

body:
On repo/branch: https://github.com/strongloop/strong-supervisor/tree/try-linters (edit: you don't have to be on branch, throws on master as well)

@kraman, you reproduced this on OS X with 0.15, and node 0.11.3, right?

```
sam@samtu:~/w/sn/strong-supervisor (master u=) % ./node_modules/.bin/eslint lib
/home/sam/w/sn/strong-supervisor/node_modules/eslint/lib/rules/consistent-return.js:55
                returnTypeDefined = "type" in returnInfo;
                                              ^
TypeError: Cannot use 'in' operator to search for 'type' in undefined
    at EventEmitter.ReturnStatement (/home/sam/w/sn/strong-supervisor/node_modules/eslint/lib/rules/consistent-return.js:55:47)
    at EventEmitter.emit (events.js:117:20)
    at Controller.controller.traverse.enter (/home/sam/w/sn/strong-supervisor/node_modules/eslint/lib/eslint.js:683:25)
    at Controller.__execute (/home/sam/w/sn/strong-supervisor/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:397:31)
    at Controller.traverse (/home/sam/w/sn/strong-supervisor/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:495:28)
    at EventEmitter.module.exports.api.verify (/home/sam/w/sn/strong-supervisor/node_modules/eslint/lib/eslint.js:676:24)
    at processFile (/home/sam/w/sn/strong-supervisor/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:172:23)
    at /home/sam/w/sn/strong-supervisor/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:271:26
    at /home/sam/w/sn/strong-supervisor/node_modules/eslint/lib/util/traverse.js:61:17
    at Array.forEach (native)
```
